cluster_thesis.text: The memory supercycle itself is intact and arguably accelerating structurally (HBM wafer share of DRAM projected 18%->30% by end-2027, TrendForce 2027 HBM contract hikes guided +80-150%), but CXMT reaching HBM3E risk production ~1yr ahead of the 2027 consensus timeline (qualification-stage, shipping samples to Alibaba T-Head/Cambricon) introduces a genuine, dated competitive threat specifically to the HBM3-tier segment SK Hynix (SKHY) has near-monopolized and to MU's commodity-DRAM crowd-out thesis. Not yet in supplier pricing -- this is a WATCH on timing and magnitude, not a deteriorating call.
cluster_thesis.falsifier: CXMT HBM3E product actually enters a hyperscaler or ASIC-maker's qualified supplier list (beyond sampling to Alibaba T-Head/Cambricon), or a tier-1 source reports a first CXMT-linked HBM3E contract price -- either would move this from qualification-stage risk to realized ASP risk.
